# vps-troubleshooting

> Layered diagnosis for a remote VPS that is slow, unreachable, or failing a site login. Measure before changing configuration. Works with any VPS and any provider.

The core lives in `skill/vps-troubleshooting/`: `SKILL.md` is the entry point for an AI agent, and each file under `references/` carries the commands and criteria for one branch.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): capability list, measured case, FAQ (Chinese)
- [English README](README.en.md): same content in English
- [Deploy](skill/vps-troubleshooting/references/deploy.md): bare host to a working egress, including transport choice
- [Slow](skill/vps-troubleshooting/references/slow-path.md): decide whether the bottleneck is the server, the path, or the client
- [Unreachable](skill/vps-troubleshooting/references/unreachable.md): layered checks for service, firewall, DNS, and path filtering
- [Login blocked](skill/vps-troubleshooting/references/login-blocked.md): separate transport failure, risk challenge, and account problems
- [Multi-device](skill/vps-troubleshooting/references/multi-device.md): subscription delivery, ruleset size, client troubleshooting

## Tools

- [inspect.sh](skill/vps-troubleshooting/scripts/inspect.sh): read-only host baseline, changes nothing
- [measure.py](skill/vps-troubleshooting/scripts/measure.py): alternating comparison, rejects unbalanced samples
- [check-links.py](scripts/check-links.py): validates relative links (repo maintenance, not part of the skill)

## Key judgements

- A single slow stream alongside fast parallel streams means per-connection congestion control, not insufficient bandwidth
- A CDN changes the entry, not the exit IP, so it does not resolve a site's risk checks
- Raw Shadowsocks cannot be fronted by a CDN; an HTTP-family transport must be chosen before installation
- BBR improves the sending side, creates no capacity, and cannot rescue a path with no headroom
- The host firewall and the provider security group are two layers; opening one is a common cause of a running but unreachable service
- An unauthenticated API `401` proves reachability only, not that an account works
